title: K-Means as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Normalized RBF Assignments: Rates, Trajectories, and Exact Recovery with Entmax
abstract: arXiv:2603.04625v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: K-Means is usually treated as a discrete procedure outside gradient-based learning, whereas normalized radial basis function (RBF) layers are smooth. We make precise the sense in which K-Means is the zero-temperature limit of such a layer. Relaxing the K-Means assignments to the simplex with a Shannon entropy penalty yields the normalized Gaussian RBF responsibilities and a reduced objective $F_\sigma$ with $0\le J-F_\sigma\le 2n\sigma^2\log k$, so $F_\sigma$ $\Gamma$-converges to the K-Means distortion $J$. We keep four levels of statement apart. For the objective, minimal values and minimizers converge, and above the critical temperature $\sigma^2=\lambda_{\max}$ all centroids at the mean form a strict local minimizer. For optimization, alternating minimization is a preconditioned gradient method on $F_\sigma$ whose hard limit is Lloyd's algorithm. For one update, under a margin $\Delta_{\min}>0$, the soft centroid map approaches L

translated_title: K-均值作为归一化RBF分配的零温度极限：收敛速率、轨迹与基于Entmax的精确恢复
translated_abstract: K-均值通常被视为一种独立于梯度学习的离散过程，而归一化径向基函数（RBF）层则是光滑的。我们精确阐明了K-均值作为此类层零温度极限的含义。通过引入香农熵惩罚将K-均值分配松弛到单纯形上，可以得到归一化高斯RBF责任度以及一个简化的目标函数F_σ，其中0≤J−F_σ≤2nσ²log k，因此F_σ Γ-收敛于K-均值的失真J。我们区分了四个层次的论述：在目标函数层面，最小值与最小化子收敛，且在临界温度σ²=λ_max之上，所有位于均值的质心构成一个严格局部极小值点；在优化层面，交替最小化是关于F_σ的预条件梯度方法，其硬性极限即为Lloyd算法；在单次更新层面，在间隔Δ_min>0的条件下，软质心映射逼近（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文严格证明了K-均值聚类是归一化RBF分配在零温度下的Γ-极限，从目标函数、优化方法、单次更新和轨迹收敛等多个层面定量刻画了软RBF分配与硬K-均值之间的联系，并利用Entmax实现了精确恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously establishes K-Means as the zero-temperature Γ-limit of normalized RBF assignments, quantifying convergence rates, optimization dynamics (alternating minimization as a preconditioned gradient method with Lloyd's algorithm as its hard limit), and exact recovery guarantees via entmax.
